test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A and B start driving simultaneously from point X and go towards point Y. X and Y are 60 km apart. A's speed is 4 km/h less than that of B. B, after reaching Y, returns and meets A at a point 12 km away from Y. Find the speed of A.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of distances covered: **A : B** = (60 − 12) : (60 + 12) = 48 : 72 = **2 : 3**.

Since time is constant, **Speed Ratio = Distance Ratio** = 2 : 3.

Difference in speed units = 3 − 2 = 1 unit.

Given speed difference = 4 km/h ⇒ 1 unit = 4 km/h.

Speed of A = 2 units = 2 × 4 = 8 km/h.

**∴ The correct answer is 8 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Total distance (X to Y) = 60 km. Speed of A is 4 km/h less than B. Meeting point is 12 km from Y.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/86cfdf625236d98d0709b46c978969a1a99959a3d3d748f6ac940e196ad067e7.png] 

Distance covered by **B** = 60 + 12 = 72 km.

Distance covered by **A** = 60 − 12 = 48 km.

Let the speed of B be **v** km/h. Then speed of A = **(v − 4)** km/h.

Since both start at the same time and meet, the **time taken** is equal.

⇒ Time = Distance / Speed

⇒ 48 / (v − 4) = 72 / v

⇒ 48v = 72(v − 4)

⇒ 2v = 3(v − 4)

⇒ 2v = 3v − 12

⇒ v = 12 km/h (Speed of B)

⇒ Speed of A = v − 4 = 12 − 4 = 8 km/h.

**∴ The correct answer is 8 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Constant Time Property

When time is constant, the ratio of distances covered is directly proportional to the ratio of speeds (D₁/D₂ = S₁/S₂).

Relative Speed in Same Direction

If two objects move in the same direction with speeds u and v ( v), the relative speed is (u − v).

Average Speed for Entire Journey

If a person travels from X to Y at speed 'a' and returns at speed 'b', Average Speed = 2ab / (a + b).</p
